written_by: Claude Code, as a worklist for a person to fill
notes: The usual order of course types for the Plan (spec 24 → Data, topic_order), from Las Positas College's current catalog prerequisites. One row per course type in the 9 Explore majors (data/raw/explore), with nothing filled in: no order is drafted. before_topic is the prerequisite: { topic: cs2, before_topic: cs1 } means take cs1 first. For each row, find the LPC course for that course type and read its prerequisites. If a prerequisite is another course type in this file, write its topic in before_topic. Add a row for each further prerequisite, and delete the row if the course has none that are course types here (a prerequisite like precalculus that isn't a course type here isn't written). Fill in source_name, source_url (the catalog page), academic_year (the catalog's year, like 2026-27) and retrieved_at (the day you checked), and delete the todo. A second person checks each row against the catalog. Then run: npm run import -- data/raw/planning/topic-order.json --dry-run
